environment.description: EKS pod running in namespace 'chat-prod' with Kubernetes Service type LoadBalancer exposing port 8080 directly. Pod has no NetworkPolicy restrictions. Ingress is a classic ELB (TCP mode) passing through raw WebSocket connections without header inspection. No Istio sidecar or service mesh. The gRPC server and WebSocket handler share the same port. PgBouncer is configured in transaction pooling mode with prepared statement support. Pod security context runs as non-root but has NET_RAW capability.
